picks.title: Blockaid Says B18TimeBank Exploit Drained 404,540 USDC
picks.summary: Onchain records confirm the payout on Base. About 106,785 USDC remained in the settlement contract during a subsequent check; containment was unconfirmed.

picks.title: Japan’s most powerful supercomputer may have been hacked, over 4,000 users’ personal data stolen
picks.summary: Fugaku, Japan s most powerful supercomputer, has suffered a suspected data breach, with the information of more than 4,000 of its users potentially stolen as a result.

picks.title: Cursor Traces Malicious Claude Code Extension to Third-Party Breach
picks.summary: A compromised key issued to AI infrastructure provider Fireworks was used by threat actors to access Cursor data and credentials.

picks.title: Binance Hack Wallets Move $137 Million in Ethereum After Two Weeks of Silence
picks.summary: A wallet linked to October’s record Binance theft moved $63 million in ether, before analysts flagged a larger wave of transfers and reported Bitcoin swaps amid ongoing U.S. recovery efforts.

picks.title: Java4Shell Vulnerability For OpenJDK Java That Can Lead To Remote Code Execution
picks.summary: Java4Shell was publicly disclosed this afternoon as the latest high profile security vulnerability in the age of AI and LLMs...

picks.title: Cloud keys leaked in Docker Hub images are stolen within seconds
picks.summary: Credentials and access secrets exposed in public Docker Hub images are being extracted and exploited by attackers within as little as eight seconds of publication. [...]

picks.title: Optimizely Malware Attacks Highlight Third-Party Vendor Risks
picks.summary: At least 178 organizations, including several major brands, unwittingly exposed website visitors to hydra-like malware via a third-party platform.

picks.title: Hundreds of websites deliver potent malware cocktail to unsuspecting visitors
picks.summary: Malware cocktail delivers cryptocurrency theft payloads and iOS exploits, among other things.

picks.title: TheMailer Phishing Kit Puts AI in the Driver s Seat
picks.summary: The commercial kit uses attacker-supplied AI models to personalize lures, evade spam filters, and scale campaigns to tens of thousands of targets.

picks.title: Bank of England Finalizes Clearing-House Test Policy
picks.summary: Blockchain-based entrants are included in a technology-neutral route for limited live testing. The new rule-waiver policy is expected to take effect in 2027.

picks.title: World Bank Taps Circle and Citi to Test Stablecoins for Development Payments
picks.summary: The institution will test whether Circle’s USDC and blockchain rails can speed up and cut the cost of disbursing development funds.
